items.title: Tencent open-sources DFly2, the speculative-decoding drafter that reuses the target's sparse KV cache, with drafters for Hy4 flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and GLM-5.3-Flash
items.summary: DFly2 drafts from the target model's own sparse-attention KV cache and top-k picks, so it keeps no cache of its own and its cost stays flat as context grows. Weights, training code (AngelSpec) and a technical report are out; the paper reports 10 to 31.5 percent more accepted tokens than DFlash and DSpark on long-context and agentic work and 62 to 81 percent more throughput serving DS-V4.1-Flash at 64K.

doubt.pushback: 4.2x is a peak decode figure; a replier reading the model card reports end-to-end averages of 2.12x (long) and 1.67x (agentic) on Hy4 flash, and vLLM support for the new MoE drafters is still in progress.

reception.summary: Repliers praise sharing the target KV cache as the real contribution and ask about acceptance at higher temperature, batch size and whether vLLM or SGLang will merge it; one notes drafters must be retrained when target weights change.

items.title: Ant Ling open-sources Ming-Image-0.2-Design, now the top open-weight model on Artificial Analysis text-to-image (1,095 Elo)
items.summary: MIT-licensed design-focused text-to-image model (6B DiT plus an MoE language encoder) for UI drafts, posters, e-commerce and text-heavy layouts at 2K. The Layer model that splits an image into editable transparent sublayers is promised for next week and is not out yet.

doubt.pushback: The 6B figure is only the DiT: repliers note the full release is about 24.9B parameters (52.9 GB repo) and the README validates one 80 GiB GPU in BF16, so it is not a consumer-GPU model yet.

reception.summary: Mostly congratulations and interest in the upcoming Layer model; practical notes on VRAM and a broken sdpa attention path, and one reply calling the outputs worse than Krea 2.

items.title: oMLX 0.8.4 doubles Inkling 2 Mini decode at 128K on Apple silicon and adds LoopCD decoding
items.summary: The Mac LLM server's new fused Metal kernels lift Inkling 2 Mini prefill 51 to 124 percent and decode up to 2x at 128K on an M5 Ultra, and Lightning MTP now works with concurrent requests (2.6x total speed for two). DeepSeek V4.1 also decodes faster with several requests at once.

items.title: Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 Action world action model tops RoboColosseum's Franka DROID open track against VLAs and LLM agents
items.summary: In blind on-the-spot prompts on a real Franka arm, the open-weight 7B FLUX 3 Action DROID model won 50 of 55 decided comparisons against five VLAs (pi0.5, GR00T N1.7, MolmoAct2, G0.5, LingBot-VLA v2) over 75 comparisons; every run and evaluator note is public.

doubt.pushback: Could not confirm the #1 rank on the JS-only leaderboard page; a search index snapshot of the leaderboard listed it third on the Franka open track (1,821 DCR over 91 comparisons).

items.title: Aleph Alpha details YASA sparse attention behind Kolibri 1.1: up to 14x decode throughput per GPU at 1M context
items.summary: Technical write-up of Yet Another Sparse Attention, which replaced Kolibri 1's dense attention in the Apache-2.0 Kolibri 1.1 open weights, with throughput, quality and training details; the small base-model quality hit is said to be recovered after post-training.

items.title: Microsoft measures coding-agent over-editing on 7,660 Copilot CLI trajectories: about 11% of agent code units are unneeded
items.summary: Delta Residue Attribution replays each trajectory and reverts every patch unit to test whether it was needed. Across 18 models, agents' code is on average at least as necessary as developers'; extra lines are mostly added tests and docs on SWE-bench Verified, and test-based pruning removes most unneeded code while 89% of pruned patches still resolve.

items.title: NVIDIA lets agents manage their own context in its NOOA harness: GPT 6.1 nearly triples its score at a 32K budget
items.summary: Models get a context API to collapse history into summaries and fetch archived events by tag. On OfficeQA Pro v2 and MLE-bench Lite from 8K to 512K budgets, models that use it well score higher with fewer tokens, and reusing the KV cache of the unchanged suffix after an edit cuts prefill compute by up to 15% with no accuracy change.

items.title: ByteDance Seed's Mixture-of-Loops Transformer passes KV memory between loops for 1.7x token efficiency at 700M
items.summary: MoLT reuses attention keys and values across loops so a looped transformer can decode in a single traversal. In 400B-token pretraining it beats OLMo3 at 700M, 1.5B and a 3B MoE, and a continued-pretraining adaptation of Qwen3.5-0.8B lowers loss on all 11 domains; code is public.

doubt.pushback: The 1.7x is token efficiency in training tokens, not a compute-matched cost saving; results are at small scale (up to 3B MoE).
